description.value: The Lac la Hache Branch is a small community library operated by the Cariboo Regional District Library system, serving the rural Lac la Hache area along Highway 97 in the Cariboo. It offers access to the full CRDL network including interlibrary loans, digital resources, and e-books through a single community librarian. For cyclists riding the Interior plateau, it is a rare public amenity in an otherwise remote stretch between 100 Mile House and Williams Lake.

address.value: 4787 Clark St, Lac La Hache, BC V0K 1T0

No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are mentioned on the website; the OSM internet_access=wlan tag cannot be treated as authoritative without website corroboration per the rules, so Wi-Fi is set to null.
